findings.problem: This figure marker sits at the end of Example #4, before the #5 heading, so the app draws it under Example #4. The renderer draws three bars (100%, 50%, 25%) labeled up to 2 half-lives, with the caption '25% remaining = 2 billion years'. Example #4 asks what is left after 3 half-lives, and its answer is 1/8. The figure under the example shows a different count and result, so a student who just found 1/8 sees a picture that seems to say 25%. The values belong to Example #5 (1 parent : 3 daughter, so 1/4 left, 2 billion years). The marker was already misplaced in the base, but the rewrite added Example #5 right after it and did not move it. Writer rule 7 keeps a marker only while it fits and asks for the exact values from the lesson.
